_about: Hand-read answer key for the ingestion benchmark. Every value was read from the document itself (a text layer, or the rendered page image for scanned pages) by a person, not produced by the importer. page = the PDF page index, 1-based. value null = the document does not state it, so the correct answer is blank. class: financial fields must be exact to the dollar; descriptive fields are matched as written. The documents are the owner's and are not in this repository: put them in a folder and pass it to om_baseline.js.
